playbooks.title: 📜 Playbook: Vim/Neovim Velocity & Development Speed
playbooks.subtitle: Synthesized rules from ThePrimeagen (Ex-Netflix Senior Engineer)

rules.rule: 1. Stop Using the Mouse; Master Motion Keys
rules.insight: Navigating code with a mouse breaks developer flow state. Master motions (`f`, `t`, `ciw`, `vap`, `%`) to edit at the speed of thought.
rules.action: Disable mouse support in your editor for 7 days to force muscle memory development.

rules.insight: Don't navigate file trees line-by-line. Jump directly between active files using mark-based buffers like Harpoon.
rules.action: Limit active working files to 4 slots in Harpoon to reduce cognitive switching cost.

rules.rule: 3. Benchmark Production Languages with Real Metrics
rules.insight: Don't trust internet hype about language speed. Benchmark Rust, Go, and TypeScript under actual HTTP load and memory allocations.
rules.action: Profile memory layout and garbage collection pauses before deciding to rewrite services.

rules.rule: 1. Charge Premium Prices by Increasing Perceived Value

rules.action: Increase your price by 2x to 5x and invest the margin directly into customer success.

rules.rule: 2. There Are Only 4 Paths to Becoming Ultra Wealthy
rules.insight: Wealth creation relies on high-leverage activities: Media, Code, Capital, and Labor. Scale through digital media and proprietary systems to decouple time from income.
rules.action: Focus 80% of your effort on building scalable distribution systems and high-margin products.

rules.rule: 3. The 2 Sales Questions That Force Decisions
rules.insight: Objections come from fear or lack of clarity. Ask prospects: 'What happens if you do nothing?' and 'How much is staying in your current state costing you?'
rules.action: Use diagnostic framing in sales conversations to highlight the real cost of inaction.
